title: This is not a good appliance
text: This is not a good appliance. I had a smaller air fryer that worked great. This one not so much! It has been hard and cleaned numerous times still has a burning plastic smell. It does not cook the food all the thru! But it's pretty good at burning it before it's finished.

product_metadata.title: GoWISE USA GWAC981 XL 5.3-Quart Air Fryer with Accessories, 10 Piece, 8 Cooking Presets + 50 Recipes (Black Premium), Qt
features: Healthier cooking: thanks to rapid air technology, you can experience your favorite fried foods in a healthier WAY. Air fried foods typically have 75% less fat than traditionally fried foods. Experience that crunchy taste with little to no oil.

Extended time & smarter cooking: The newest series of GoWISE USA Air fryers feature an extended cooking time up to 60 minutes and a wide temperature range of 170F - 400F. Air fry like a Pro with 8 built-in cooking presets designed with the optimal times and temperatures for your air frying needs. The presets include fries, pork, chicken, shrimp, steak, cake, vegetables, and fish.

Xl size + 50 Starter recipes: enjoy quick, easy, and delicious meals Immediately with 50 Starter recipes! Get more tips, tricks and recipes through our influencers on social media and our gowise community. Capable of cooking 4 burgers at the same time and easily filling a large bowl of fries, this XL 5.3-Quart air fryer allows you to make family-sized quantities in a compact air fryer that is easy to store under kitchen cabinets or anywhere else.

Bonus accessory set: want to do more than just fry? Transform your air fryer into an oven, grill, toaster, and more with the one-piece accessory set. This air fryer comes with a kabob rack, toasting rack, standard rack, baking pan, pizza pan, resting Mat, silicone muffin tin, and a pack of parchment paper! Remove all hot accessories and dishes with ease by using the included silicone mitts or clamp tongs.

Safe & guaranteed: ETL certified and designed with several safety features including automatic shut off to prevent overheating and a cool-touch handle equipped with a button guard to prevent accidental detachment. Your purchase includes is a 1-year purchase Warranty and free lifetime support from GoWISE USA.
description: GoWISE USA air fryer XL with 8 cooking presets helps in the cooking of fried snacks and food with little or no oil.
